title: why nail scores 63 single-domain pid decoys 3+ bits under hmmer even with a seed inside hmmer's domain
body: reports/pid-2026-09-24/singles.tbl covers the 372 single-domain decoys among hmmer.prf's top 500 unrejected decoys, where nail should match hmmer whenever it gets a seed. 254 are within 1 bit and 55 are 1-3 bits short. 63 fall more than 3 bits short even with --full-dp or a synthetic seed; BUD22, Vitellogenin_N and Zip recur among them. Each decoy has a pairs/ directory in the report with every search run on it.
close_reason: Jack: a question never asked and not wanted
